name: platform_orders
comment: Line-grain orders sold through third-party e-commerce marketplaces (e.g. Amazon, Flipkart). One row per line item per order. Channel: PLATFORM.

columns.name: hash_key
columns.comment: Deterministic hash of this record's natural/business key, generated during ingestion. Used internally for deduplication and change-detection; not a business attribute and should not be used for reporting.

columns.name: marketplace
columns.comment: Name of the third-party marketplace this order was placed on (e.g. Amazon, Flipkart).

columns.name: order_id
columns.comment: Marketplace's own order identifier.

columns.name: order_date
columns.comment: Date the order was placed on the marketplace.

columns.name: product_title
columns.comment: Product title as listed on the marketplace for this order line.

columns.name: marketplace_sku
columns.comment: Marketplace's own SKU/listing identifier for this product, prior to mapping onto the canonical product_id.

columns.name: units
columns.comment: Quantity of this product ordered on this line.

columns.name: unit_price
columns.comment: Unit price charged for this line on the marketplace, in INR, before fees and discounts.

columns.name: marketplace_fee
columns.comment: Commission/fee charged by the marketplace on this order line, in INR.

columns.name: promo_discount
columns.comment: Discount amount applied to this line by a marketplace promotion, in INR.

columns.name: ship_to_city
columns.comment: City the order was shipped to.

columns.name: ship_to_country
columns.comment: Country the order was shipped to.

columns.name: fulfillment_status
columns.comment: Current fulfillment status of this order on the marketplace (e.g. Pending, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled).

columns.name: channel_code
columns.comment: Short code identifying the sales channel this record belongs to (e.g. D2C, OFFLINE, QCOMM, PLATFORM, INTL, CAFE). Joins to dim_channels for the channel's full name, group and settlement currency.

columns.name: insert_timestamp
columns.comment: UTC timestamp when this record was first loaded into the silver layer. Reflects pipeline load time, not a business event time.

columns.name: modified_timestamp
columns.comment: UTC timestamp when this record was last updated by the ingestion pipeline. Reflects pipeline processing time, not a business event time.

columns.name: source_name
columns.comment: Name of the upstream source system or source file this record was ingested from. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting, not for business analysis.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.comment: Soft-delete flag set by the ingestion pipeline when the source record was removed or tombstoned upstream. Rows where this is TRUE should normally be excluded from business reporting.

columns.name: order_date_key
columns.comment: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the order/transaction occurred, derived from the transaction timestamp. Use this column (not the raw timestamp) to join to dim_date for month/quarter/year reporting.

columns.name: product_id
columns.comment: Canonical product/SKU identifier. Joins to item_master for product name, category and brand.
